name: Periglacial-Polje

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past dust seas stretching to the horizon, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on silicon, copper, solar potential and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
